items.t: Plastic cooling parts crack and the engine overheats
items.job: Cooling system refresh: radiator, expansion tank, thermostat, water pump and hoses
items.note: Doing the whole set at once costs less in labor than replacing parts one at a time.

items.t: Electric water pump fails without warning
items.job: Replace electric water pump and thermostat
items.note: Most shops replace the thermostat at the same time.

items.t: Electric power steering feels sticky or notchy
items.job: Replace electric power steering column motor assembly
items.note: Sometimes cleaning and greasing the column joints is enough, which costs much less.

items.t: Convertible top pump fails or gets flooded
items.job: Replace convertible top hydraulic pump
items.note: Moving the pump higher in the trunk helps keep it dry in the future.

items.t: VANOS valve timing seals wear out
items.job: Reseal VANOS unit
items.note: An independent specialist typically charges $500 to $900 total.

items.t: VANOS failure on the M Roadster and M Coupe
items.job: Rebuild S54 VANOS unit
items.note: Shops quote about $800 to $1,500 total.

items.t: Valve cover and oil filter housing gaskets leak oil
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket
items.note: The oil filter housing gasket is a separate job of similar cost.

items.t: Crankcase vent valve clogs and the engine burns oil
items.job: Replace crankcase vent valve and hoses

items.t: Valvetronic eccentric shaft sensor fails
items.job: Replace Valvetronic eccentric shaft sensor
items.note: Parts price varies a lot between genuine and aftermarket sensors.

items.t: Power window regulator breaks
items.job: Replace power window regulator

items.t: Rear trailing arm bushings wear out
items.job: Replace rear trailing arm bushings (pair)

items.t: Front control arm bushings wear, vague steering or shake when braking
items.job: Replace front lower control arm bushings and align

items.t: Water leaks into the trunk
items.job: Replace trunk lid or third brake light seal

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensor on the 1.9L
items.job: Replace oxygen sensor

items.t: Cruise control cable can hold the throttle open (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Fuel pump vapor lock can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Crankcase vent heater can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Battery cable connector can cut power and stall the car (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump fails on the sDrive35i
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Check with a BMW dealer whether your car already had the updated pump.

items.t: Leaking or misfiring fuel injectors on the sDrive35i
items.job: Replace fuel injectors
items.note: Low end is one or two injectors; high end is all six.

items.t: Timing chain guides wear on the 2.0L turbo
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: Uses the updated BMW parts. Price varies a lot if the engine has already been damaged.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump can fail and the pedal gets hard (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Water pump connector can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Retractable hardtop stops working or opens partway
items.job: Diagnose and replace a hardtop position sensor or switch
items.note: A failed hydraulic pump or cylinder costs much more.

items.t: Bent or cracked wheels on low-profile run-flat tires
items.job: Replace one damaged alloy wheel
items.note: Some bent wheels can be straightened; cracked wheels should be replaced.

items.t: Rearview camera image can go missing (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Brake assist can drop out right after starting (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Starter or starter relay can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free at a BMW dealer. Check your VIN to see if the work was already done.

items.t: Oil filter housing gasket leaks on the M40i
items.job: Replace oil filter housing gasket

items.t: Coolant expansion tank and hoses seep coolant
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank

items.t: Electric water pump or thermostat fails on the M40i
items.job: Replace electric water pump and thermostat

items.t: Front control arm bushings wear and clunk
items.job: Replace front control arms and align
